cases.prompt: Dịch toàn bộ vi-source.md sang JP.
checks: Preserve conditional six-week pilot, both conditions, >=3 target companies, <=2 million yen, unapproved status
Preserve self-report vs independent verification; interest vs purchase commitment; technical vs business feasibility
150 million yen equals 1億5,000万円; 8% to 5% is 3 percentage points
Preserve all 3 rows, source IDs, URLs including query/anchor, and all/no-exception scope
No tool credits or QA prose inside the JP report

cases.prompt: Chỉ review en-jp-draft.md với en-source.md; không sửa báo cáo.
checks: Detect AND/OR, consideration/execution, approval guarantee and proposal/approved-plan errors
Detect attribution/verification change and omitted purchase commitments
Detect no-market-demand inference, scenario removal, revenue/profit error
Preserve original files; separate meaning errors from style suggestions

cases.prompt: Sửa ja-only.md cho tự nhiên, chỉ có bản Nhật; xóa credit công cụ cuối bài, không có tên công cụ/tác giả ngoài trong bản giao.
checks: Keep willingness to pay unconfirmed, investigation a proposal, and approval still pending
Do not claim comparison to unavailable original-language source
No new external author/tool credits in report or delivery note
